title: Trivia Event
description: A single trivia event: title, optional subtitle, and an ordered list of slides.

title.description: Title shown on the auto-generated title slide.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle on the title slide.

slides.description: Ordered list of slides. Slide types: category, question, image, custom.

imageRef.description: Image reference. Bare name (e.g. `kfr`) resolves to cdn/images/<name>.<ext>. `./name` resolves to the event's images/ folder. Absolute paths and http(s):// URLs pass through.

reveal.description: When the image appears. `question` = visible immediately. `answer` = appears with the answer fragment. Default: `answer`.

position.description: Where the image is laid out. `side` = right column next to text (default). `center` = hero, fills available space.

categorySlide.title: Category slide
categorySlide.description: Section divider with a large title (and optional subtitle/images).

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle below the category name.

images.description: Optional decorative images shown below the title.

questionSlide.title: Question slide
questionSlide.description: A trivia question. Top-level fields drive the slide deck (presentation-layer); the optional `config` block is server-side configuration sent to Trivia Wizard at question creation.

id.description: Stable 3-letter alpha ID. Display number is assigned by order of first appearance. Two slides with the same id share the same question number (useful for follow-up/context slides). When multiple slides with the same id carry settings, the first occurrence's `config` and per-question overrides win.

answer.description: The answer (revealed as a fragment). Slide-deck only — not sent to the server.

choices.description: Multiple-choice options (rendered A/B/C/...). When `questionKind` is omitted, presence of `choices` implies `multipleChoice` with `numOptions` derived from the array length.

matching.description: Two-column matching exercise (numbered left, lettered right). Slide-deck only.

images.description: Question images. Use object form to control reveal timing and position.

timerDuration.description: Per-question timer override in seconds. Applied at question-creation time; host UI edits during the game take precedence. Omitted = current global default.

questionPoints.description: Points awarded for this question. Applied at question-creation time. Omitted = current global default.

bonusIncrement.description: Bonus increment override for this question. Applied at question-creation time. Omitted = current global default.

speedBonusEnabled.description: Whether the speed bonus applies to this question. Applied at question-creation time. Omitted = current global default.

questionKind.description: Server-side question kind. Omitted = current global default at question-creation time, except presence of `choices` implies `multipleChoice`.

imageSlide.title: Image slide
imageSlide.description: Title text plus a centered image (e.g. join-game QR code).

image.description: Image reference (same rules as question images).

questionConfig.title: Question configuration
questionConfig.description: Server-side configuration sent to Trivia Wizard when this question is created. Fields are interpreted according to `questionKind`; settings that don't match the kind are ignored by the server. Any field omitted falls back to the current global default at question-creation time. Host UI edits during the game always take precedence and are never reverted.

numAnswers.description: [multiAnswer] Number of answer slots teams fill in.

optionType.description: [multipleChoice] Format of the option labels teams pick from.

numOptions.description: [multipleChoice] Number of options. Defaults to `choices.length` if `choices` is set; otherwise the current global default.

scoringMode.description: [numeric] How submitted numbers are scored. Other numeric settings (rangeType/rangeValue/numWinners/rangeScoringType) remain host-adjusted at game time.

fullPointsDistanceKm.description: [map] Within this distance of the correct location, full points are awarded.

onePointDistanceKm.description: [map] Distance at which a team scores exactly 1 point. Beyond this distance, scoring rounds to zero.

customSlide.title: Custom slide
customSlide.description: Escape hatch: load HTML from a file or inline.

file.description: Path to an HTML file. `./slides/foo.html` resolves to the event's slides/ folder.
